data.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOCK")"
while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do
  if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then
    echo "STALE: removing plain-file lock violation" >&2
    rm -f "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  if [ -d "$LOCK" ]; then
    holder=$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$holder" ] && ! kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "STALE: reaping dead holder $holder" >&2
      rm -rf "$LOCK"
      continue
    fi
    if [ -z "$holder" ] && ! pgrep -f '"'lake build AlgebraicJacobian' >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "'$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) )) -gt 900 ]; then
      echo "STALE: reaping old unowned lock" >&2
      rm -rf "$LOCK"
      continue
    fi
  fi
  sleep 10
done
echo $$ > "$LOCK/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ "$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$$" ]; then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
lake build AlgebraicJacobian'
